positive.prompt: As a Staff agent engineer, run a strict team-shared review of this Skill. Do not edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke RateMySkill, build the real resource graph, identify missing and mismatched paths, separate core breakage from stale metadata and harmless extra files, and avoid claiming unchecked behavior.
positive.expected_result_shape: A compact verdict with stable finding IDs, exact paths and evidence, impact, minimum fixes, acceptance tests, and no more than three priority actions.

positive.prompt: As a red-team reviewer, perform a privileged-automation audit of this Skill. Do not run its scripts.

positive.prompt: As a skill user, run a strict review and tell me whether this Skill is actually worth installing.
